desc: Spin Dash against Mario's other moves (#51): a jump, the hammer and the partner's move (X) each end a spin under way at once, and A, B and X never start one; L at a standstill still spins after them (after the partner's move, Goombella's Tattle of the place is read through to control before the last L: two fixed presses left her text up and Mario without control)
log_must: \[spin\] Mario's spin ends \((another move|off the ground)\)
\[spin\] Mario's spin ends \(its end\)|\[spin\] Mario's spin ends \(a wall\)
